1202: Information on the available FFU commands
1206:
/Apply-Ffu /ImageFile:<path_to_image_file> /ApplyDrive:<physical_drive_path> 
  [/SFUFile:<pattern>] 

  Applies an .ffu image to a specified physical drive. 
  Use /SFUFile to reference split FFU files (SFUs). <pattern> is the naming 
  pattern and location of split files. 

    Examples: 
      DISM.exe /Apply-Ffu /ImageFile:flash.ffu 
        /ApplyDrive:\\.\PhysicalDrive0
1208:
Splits an existing .ffu file into multiple read-only
                            split FFU files.
1209:
/Split-Ffu 
  /ImageFile:<path_to_image_file> /SFUFile:<path_to_sfu> /FileSize:<MB-Size> 
  [/CheckIntegrity] 

  Splits an existing .ffu file into multiple read-only split FFU files. 
  Use /FileSize to specify the maximum size in megabytes (MB) for each 
  created file. 

    Example: 
      DISM.exe /Split-Image /ImageFile:flash.ffu /SFUFile:flash.sfu 
        /FileSize:650
1211: Captures a physical disk image into a new FFU file.
1212:
/Capture-Ffu /ImageFile:<path_to_image_file> /CaptureDrive:<physical_drive_path> 
  /Name:<Name>
  [/Description:Description] [/PlatformIds:<platform_ids>] 
  [/Compress:{default|none}] 

  Captures a physical disk image to a new FFU file. 
  Use /PlatformIds to specify one or more platform ids (separate with semicolon) 
  to be added to the image. If not specified, platform id will be '*'. 
  Use /Compress to specify the type of compression used for the initial capture 
  operation. 

    Example: 
      DISM.exe /Capture-Ffu /ImageFile:install.ffu 
        /CaptureDrive:\\.\PhysicalDrive0 /Name:Drive0 
        /PlatformIds:Microsoft.MSM8994.P6211 
        /Compress:default
1214:
Optimizes a FFU file so that it can be applied to storage 
                            of a different size.
1215:
/Optimize-Ffu /ImageFile:<path_to_image_file> 
  [/PartitionNumber:<partition_number>] 

  Optimizes a FFU image. 
  Use /PartitionNumber to specify the partition to be optimized. If it is not 
  specified, the default is the partition that has Windows installed. 

    Example: 
      DISM.exe /Optimize-Ffu /ImageFile:flash.ffu
